values.note: Reservations close 4 days before arrival. Sites must be occupied within 26 hours of the reservation start or they go to walk-ups. No site swapping; one vehicle included, extras $8 a night.

values.note: Single site $29, double $58, triple $88. An Arapaho National Recreation Area pass is also required (rec.gov: $5 a day, $10 three days, $15 a week, $30 a year); an Interagency Pass covers it.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231861/rates (Peak 2026-05-08 to 2026-10-10, 2027 and 2028: 29) + FS page ('Single Site: $29 per night / Double Site: $58 / Triple Site: $88') + rec.gov notice ('fees are $5 a day, $10 for three days, $15 a week or $30 per year') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/arapaho-national-recreation-area ('Green Ridge Fee Area'; 'If you have an Interagency Pass, you don't need to purchase an ANRA Pass'), read 2026-10-27
